title: Ravenry built-in providers, version 1: the provider contract
description: The read-only data a page file can name in source.provider, and the field names of each provider's items. These names are part of the page format: they freeze at the public launch, and after it they only grow (a new field, a new provider), never rename or retype. Dates are ISO 8601 text. A field with no value is left out, so has: <field> and not: { has: <field> } work on all of them. A list of objects names its entries' fields under fields. An enum lists every value it can take today.
